exposure: infant feeding practices (breastfeeding, mixed feeding, formula feeding)
cohort: The study included 42 infants born to mothers with gestational diabetes and 28 infants born to mothers without gestational diabetes.
finding: At 1 year of age, breastfed infants demonstrated significantly lower weight, length, BMI, and subscapular skinfold thickness (in boys) compared to formula-fed infants, while maternal gestational diabetes had no significant impact on infant anthropometrics up to one year.
